run_bayesian_optimization_ackley: run Bayesian optimization on the Ackley benchmark function with specified dimensions and iterations
run_bayesian_optimization_levy: run Bayesian optimization on the Levy benchmark function with specified dimensions and iterations
run_gp_minimize_with_ei: run Gaussian process minimization using expected improvement acquisition function and sampling optimizer
run_bo_with_initial_points: run Bayesian optimization with 40 initial points and a specified number of total calls
run_bo_cli_with_args: run the Bayesian optimization CLI with --func, --dims, and --iterations arguments
